I hold a PhD in neuroscience from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and now work as a Senior Sales Engineer at [Atropos Health](https://www.atroposhealth.com/). Before that, I spent two and a half years building validated, open-source R tools for clinical trials at [Atorus Research Inc.](https://www.atorusresearch.com/)

### Interests

-   Real-world evidence
-   Open-source software for clinical data (R, pharmaverse)
-   Biotechnology
-   Clinical research & analytics
-   Translational medicine
-   Data science
-   Data visualization
